newsitem.title: USA: Shell Texas coker running at reduced rate.
newsitem.headline: Shell Texas coker running at reduced rate.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said Monday a coker at its Deer Park refinery near Houston has been running at reduced rate since an operational problem occurred Sunday.
The company declined to give details on the problem or by how much the "delayed" coker has been reduced.
"We did experience some operational problems and early Sunday morning we adjusted the rates," said Shell spokesman Dennis Winkler, adding there was no impact on product supply.
Winkler said workers were currently bringing the 50,000 barrel per day unit back up to normal levels.
Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859 1631
